name: altpbf
description: ALTPBF — a tiny binary format for elevation tiles: delta-coded SVarint grids with deflate-raw, decoded straight into Int16Array (no intermediate JS arrays). The elevation backbone of ortho-earth: 8 tiles / 55 MB cover the whole planet at R90. Encode, decode, name-scheme helpers and PNG preview, all in the browser. MIT.
author: Kenji Yoshida <kenji.yoshida.home.2026@gmail.com>
